hold_reason: Refunds mismatch: Alpha reported refunds applied for orders 292 (2929) and 294 (10248) as complete, but signed batch refund requests include also order 295 (9055). Ledger list_refunds shows only 292 and 294, so refund for 295 may be missing.

reply.thought: Need to verify refunds completeness against ledger and then pay each customer net balance. I will list orders and refunds, then compute via net_balance per customer and record payouts.
Now verify refunds list in ledger via list_refunds, then use net_balance per customer and record one payout per customer.

Alpha claims refunds complete, but ledger shows only two refunds applied (292, 294) while batch signed refund requests include an additional refund for order 295. This mismatch suggests refund work for this batch is not complete/correct, so I will hold for human review rather than pay potentially incorrect net balances.
